decisions: The new lake.equity_ingest module uses injected T033 client, T022 writer factory, and an AtomicIngestCommitter boundary so both staged Parquet objects and both T024 CoverageRecord rows publish in one commit.
Trades and quotes are fetched concurrently for one canonical symbol and CoverageSession bounds; no external write starts until both requests succeed.
T022 ParquetWriter normalizes records against the stable T021 schemas, while the transaction validates symbol and session membership and sorts records by deterministic keys before staging.
Closed sessions produce complete or empty coverage; open sessions produce partial coverage; provider or normalization failures publish two error rows and no objects through the same atomic boundary.
Deterministic date-first object paths and replace semantics make repeated runs safe: a retry replaces the same two objects and catalog keys rather than appending duplicates.
limitations: The existing T022 ObjectStore and T024 CatalogRepository protocols do not provide a cross-object/catalog transaction primitive, so the new AtomicIngestCommitter protocol is an explicit injected backend boundary; tests use an in-memory atomic fake.

The transaction stages both Parquet payloads privately, calls the committer only after both fetches and normalization succeed, and publishes error coverage with no objects on provider or normalization failure.
No live Alpaca, Azure Blob, Azure Table, credentials, network access, or MyPy run was used.
The shared worktree contains unrelated user changes and untracked files; none were modified, staged, reverted, or committed by T034.
